mapper.sql: from sys_client c inner join sys_user_type ut on ut.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and ut.status = '0' and ut.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user_type_rel utr on utr.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and utr.user_id = #{userId} and utr.status = '0' where c.status = '0' and c.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, d.dept_name, d.dept_category from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'

select distinct r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.data_scope from sys_role r inner join sys_client c on c.id = r.client_id inner join sys_user_type ut on ut.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and ut.status = '0' and ut.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user_type_rel utr on utr.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and utr.user_id = #{userId} and utr.status = '0' left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id and ur.user_id = #{userId} where c.status = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id = c.default_role_id or ur.user_id is not null) order by r.role_id

select distinct r.role_id, m.perms as permission from sys_role r inner join sys_client c on c.id = r.client_id inner join sys_user_type ut on ut.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and ut.status = '0' and ut.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_user_type_rel utr on utr.user_type_id = c.user_type_id and utr.user_id = #{userId} and utr.status = '0' left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id and ur.user_id = #{userId} inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id and m.client_id = r.client_id and m.status = '0' where c.status = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id = c.default_role_id or ur.user_id is not null) and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' order by r.role_id, m.perms
